1.h3 d5 2.a3.strategy: A second move on the rim, aimed at a quick c4 against the d5 pawn and at keeping a black bishop off b4. It is sound but passive: Black keeps the freer centre.

1.h3 d5 2.a3 e5.strategy: Adds a second central pawn, so Black owns a broad centre while White has spent two moves on the edge pawns. White now has to show that the flank set-up is worth the lost time, and Black can simply develop and play for the centre.
1.h3 d5 2.a3 e5.name: Creepy Crawly Formation: Classical Defence
